receipt.result_detail: attributable residual-codec ladder over the fixed S8 winner residual (8 effectiveness clips) and 42 representative Phase-M channel streams: pre-E family vs the Seal E1 signed/FSM adaptive range coder (id 16), the Seal E2 SSE/APM-corrected variant (id 17) and the Seal E3 matched-lag variant (id 18), with the selected minimum reported; result sha256 bfa2b7b684e5947e4e1e260e7154cf47a7ebb5e47b3a68f3df77c0d9057c49a6
limitations: learned prediction is an experimental profile: it does not change u1/v1, the literal fallback remains mandatory, and negative learned results are preserved rather than hidden
attribution is codec-only because the dense residual is held fixed; the portfolio-wide effect appears in the `learned-speech` and `learned-u1-wasted` courts
the Phase-M population uses a cheaper predictor than voice does and exists only to test whether the coder generalizes beyond speech
wall-clock per-sample timings are recorded as extras and are never hashed

method.fixed_predictor: the S8 portfolio winner per effectiveness clip and a cheap exact fixed-difference closure per Phase-M channel; the dense residual is identical for every codec
method.e1_codec: forward carry-less binary range coder (LZMA arithmetic coder) with online 12-bit adaptive probabilities over the residual-event FSM state, previous magnitude bucket, previous sign, unary-length position and decoded value prefix
method.e2_codec: the same base coder with an SSE/APM stage: the base 12-bit probability is quantized in the integer stretch domain into 33 interpolation points and adaptively corrected under a phase × magnitude-bucket context, then interpolated
method.e3_codec: the SSE/APM coder with a matched-lag context: the encoder stores a decoder-visible lag (0..=128, or 0 for none) chosen from the residual's own autocorrelation, and the lagged residual magnitude bucket widens the SSE context; the lag never alters a value
method.e4_codec: a PAQ-light residual context mixer: six context experts (position, previous magnitude, previous sign, FSM state, prefix×lag, magnitude×lag) are combined by an integer logistic mixer whose weights are trained online to minimize -log P(bit), then the mixed probability drives the same range coder
method.e5_codec: full RCM research mode: the E4 mixture is followed by an ISSE stage whose expanded context (phase × token position × previous magnitude × FSM state) selects a 4+4 bit-history state that indexes an adaptive probability map correcting the mixed probability
method.binarization: sign bit, then Exp-Golomb(0) of |r| (identical to Seal E0)
method.mode_c: deliberately not measured (held out from architecture tuning)

protocol.semantic_authority: none: a learned hypothesis is a candidate family, never truth; scalar exact closure decides acceptance
